description: Get or create a Discord text channel for a Runrun.it client (1 channel per client, use client_name always avaliable transform to slug. ex: 'Client 1' -> 'client-1'). Returns channel_id and channel_name. Use before runrunit_discord_send_message to ensure the channel exists.

client_id.description: Runrun.it client ID (or number as string)

client_name.description: Client name (used for channel name if client_id not provided)

name: runrunit_discord_get_or_create_channel
